**Rosenstock S** refers to Stine Rosenstock, a clinical epidemiologist and associate professor at Aarhus University Hospital [^src1]. This page specifically documents her work and should not be confused with other individuals who share the same name [^src1].

Rosenstock is a researcher actively involved in multiple studies utilizing data from the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen) [^src1]. Her research contributions include work on peptic ulcer perforation and quality improvement initiatives in acute surgical care [^src1]. Her name is listed as an author in several scientific references within the 2024 Annual Report for the Acute Surgery Database, a publication by the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute [^src1]. This report underscores the database's role as a central tool for clinical quality development and research in acute surgery in Denmark, documenting scientific activity that builds upon its data [^src1].
